A '''pale-skinned [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Tork]]<ref name="TSWHS" /> and [[Sosio Kakra]] were a members of this species.<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who" />

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] features, with [[Color/Legends|pale blue]]<ref name="TSWHS" /> or white skin<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who" /> and pink [[eye]]s.<ref name="BtM" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="tt">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref> two members of this species, [[Tork]]<ref name="TSWHS" /> and [[Sosio Kakra]],<ref name="BtM" /> were employed at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], working directly under the nightshift [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]].<ref name="TSWHS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species made their debut within ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="TSWHS" /> which released on [[November 17]], [[1978]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref>
